subtitle: Forge Reliability — Radiant Talent Atlas & Discord Delivery
changes: Discord release announcements now follow dedicated version-record publication rather than unrelated website validation workflows.
Automatic Discord delivery uses GitHub version tags to skip releases that already have a confirmed message receipt.
Replaced the older assassin wallpaper inside the actual Talent Atlas tree with Radiant Warrior art, including the compiled stylesheet used by visitors.
Added optional compact talent nodes and quick-use instructions, while keeping original rank buttons, inspector, minimap, zoom and saved tree positions.
Preserved build data, Blizzard source IDs, Music/Media Studio, connected account features and mobile/desktop compatibility.
